title: Needle entry on the patient
view: Seated patient from behind, head bent forward, close on the back of the head; the patient's right is on the image right.
teachingPoint: Find the occipital artery under a fingertip at the base of the skull, a third of the way out to the mastoid, and enter just medial to it.
claims: Gloved index fingertip on the occipital artery at the base of the skull on the patient's right, about 2 cm from the midline (record steps and anatomy).
Needle entering just medial to the fingertip, toward the skull (record steps: perpendicular to the skin until resistance).
Dashed white: the midline. Dashed red ring: the artery under the fingertip.
Labels: Occipital artery under the fingertip, Entry, just medial.

geometry.why: entry medial to the artery (patient's right on the image right, midline to the left)
